mapper.select: select m.* from market_favorite f join market m on f.market_id = m.id where f.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 1 order by f.gmt_create desc
select market_id from market_favorite where user_id = #{userId} order by gmt_create desc
mapper.insert: insert ignore into market_favorite(user_id, market_id, gmt_create) values (#{userId}, #{marketId}, now())
mapper.delete: delete from market_favorite where user_id = #{userId} and market_id = #{marketId}
